title: Medical test arithmetic
question: For a constructed 100-case table, what are sensitivity, specificity and predictive values at a fixed test threshold?

diagnostic.reference: Reference labels and a binary threshold are assumed for this arithmetic example; no actual reference procedure was conducted.
